current_assumptions.provenance: Separate authored event-demonstration control scenario, frozen before production outputs. The selected inventory, reserve, 1-day processing delay, 95% recovery, 30-day annual outages, service trip thresholds, 60-day replacement, and energy conversion assumptions are tunable scenario inputs only. No value is a measured, optimized, or qualified ARC parameter; all inventory, availability, self-sufficiency, materials, thermal-cycle, and net-energy interpretations are conditional. Restart hysteresis is set to 0.6 kg to prevent arbitrarily short fuel-starved restart pulses around the 0.5 kg reserve. The 1e25/4e21 n/m² thresholds are intended to exercise replaceable and permanent service logic in software; actual trigger sequences depend on sampled transport point rates and other events. These values are not physical predictions. Decay constant uses NUBASE2020 Table I, article page 030001-19 (PDF page 20), tritium row, 12.32(2) Julian years.
